# Uniswap Universal Router Decoder & Encoder

> Python SDK — with a command line interface and an MCP server — to decode and encode transactions sent to the
> Uniswap Universal Router, supporting Uniswap V2, V3 and V4. It is read-only: it never signs or broadcasts a
> transaction.

Built on [web3.py](https://github.com/ethereum/web3.py). Targets Ethereum Mainnet by default and works on any chain
where the Universal Router is deployed.

## Install

```bash
pip install uniswap-universal-router-decoder          # Python API
pip install 'uniswap-universal-router-decoder[mcp]'   # + the ur-mcp MCP server
```

## Public surfaces

- **Python API** — `RouterCodec` / `AsyncRouterCodec`; public `encoder` and `decoder` modules.
- **CLI** — `ur-decode` (`tx`, `calldata`, `error`, `v3-path`) and `ur-encode` (`list`, `describe`, `build`, `v3-path`),
  which print JSON to stdout. `ur-decode tx` needs an RPC endpoint (`--rpc`, defaulting to `$RPC_URL`).
- **MCP server** — `ur-mcp`, a side-effect-free Model Context Protocol server over stdio, exposing 8 tools:
  `list_commands`, `describe_command`, `decode_transaction`, `decode_calldata`, `encode_calldata`, `decode_error`,
  `decode_v3_path`, `encode_v3_path`. Only `decode_transaction` needs an RPC endpoint (`rpc_url` argument or
  `RPC_URL` / `ETH_RPC_URL`).

## Notes

- The MCP server is registered with the MCP Registry as
  `io.github.Elnaril/uniswap-universal-router-decoder`.
- Not every Universal Router function is rebuildable through the CLI / MCP tools: the three structured commands
  (`V4_SWAP`, `V4_POSITION_MANAGER_CALL`, `EXECUTE_SUB_PLAN`) are decode-only. `ur-encode list` / `list_commands`
  report the rebuildable flag for each command.
- The decoder's JSON output (`decoded_input_to_dict()`) is also the input format of `Encoder.function_input()`, the
  `ur-encode build` CLI command and the `encode_calldata` MCP tool.
- The MCP tools are annotated as read-only (`readOnlyHint`), and only `decode_transaction` as open-world
  (`openWorldHint`).
